game.rules:

- Playing on an emulator is banned.
- Playing on a modified game file is banned.

- Don't submit your time with milliseconds.

**Video:**

- Video submissions must be free and watchable to everyone and be uploaded to either:
- YouTube or Google Drive (as a public or unlisted video).
- BiliBili.
- A game capture device is not required.
- Phone, tablet or camera recording is allowed as long as the gameplay is recognizable.
- Your speedrun can be split up into a maximum of 5 videos.
- Video quality must not be lower than 360p (640x360, 15fps)
- Runs with missing footage may be rejected on a case by case basis.

categories.name: Any% Restricted
categories.rules:
**Main Rules:**

- Defeat Mr. Grizz on a new file.
- You can not take advantage of the tricks that are listed in the **Banned Tricks** section at the bottom of these rules. 

**Timing:**

- Time starts when the black screen appears after either pressing the ‘The Crater’ button or when entering via the grate.
- Time ends when the laser reticle completely disappears.
- If you are playing on version 4.0.0, 4.0.1 or 4.0.2: your time will be 6 seconds shorter on the leaderboards to compensate for slower loading times.

**Video:**

- The version number must be visible and legible.
- Speedruns that are within the top 5 placements require clearly audible game audio.
- All speedruns faster than a 1:22:00 must have permanent video proof present.
- Speedruns without video proof must submit their splits with a picture in the description, or with a splits.io link.

**Banned Tricks:**

> **All Levels:**  
> - All tricks that have been patched out before version 4.1.0 are banned. (Pause Abuse, Menu Storage, Surge Rolls, 5-13 Puzzle Skip)  
> >
> **Site 1:**  
> - Skipping 1-1 by surgerolling up a ledge is banned.
> - Skipping the 800 Egg Fuzzy Ooze by 1-3 is banned. 
> - However doing this variant from the right side by unlocking the 200 Egg Fuzzy Ooze is allowed.  
> - Skipping the initial Deep Cut introduction cutscene in Site 1 is banned.  
> >
> **Site 2:**  
> - Skipping the 900 Egg Fuzzy Ooze by 2-3 is banned. (Discount Fries Skip)  
> >
> **Site 3:**  
> - Skipping the 600 Egg Fuzzy Ooze by 3-1 (Corporate Splatter/その丘、上品な喧噪をまとい。) is banned.  
> - Skipping the 700 Egg Fuzzy Ooze by jumping around it or unlocking 3-3 (Ink Wheels/ヌリホイールが開拓する、無限大の未来。) and super jumping to it is banned.  
> - Skipping the 2000 Egg Fuzzy Oozes that are blocking the Site entrances towards Sites 4/5 are banned. (Moxy Skip/Stupid Skip)  
> >
> **Site 4:**  
> - Clipping out of bounds with a 25 Power Egg Can to unlock the Shiver Kettle from underneath is banned. (Shiver Clip)  
> - Squidrolling on Master Mega to gain extra height is banned. (Shiver Skip)
> >
> **Site 5:**  
> - Skipping the 3000 Egg Fuzzy Ooze leading to the entrance of Site 6 is banned. (Owen Skip)  
> >
> **Rocket:**  
> - Skipping the Deep Cut cutscene in the beginning of Rocket by going around it is banned. (Nether Skip)  
> - Using a Squid Roll to climb up the red pipe in the Intermission Phase after Phase 1, going out of bounds, and skipping straight to Phase 4 is banned. (Switch Skip)  
> - Going out of bounds using the Zipcaster in Phase 4 of Rocket is banned.  
> - Dying in the Grizz boss fight to gain extra powereggs is banned.

categories.name: All Weapons + All Collectables
categories.rules:
**Main Rules:**

- Collect all Sunken Sea Scrolls, Sardinium, Gold Records, and Decorations from Site 1 to 6 on a new file.
- Complete all levels with every weapon.
- This includes all of Crater, Sites 1-6, Rocket, and After Alterna.
- You can not take advantage of tricks that are only doable in versions 1.2.1 and earlier.

**Timing:**

- Time starts when the black screen appears after either pressing the ‘The Crater’ button or when entering via the grate.
- Time ends when the words “Mission Complete” appear after completing After Alterna.
- Or when the yellow flash appears after picking up the last collectable.
- If you are playing on version 4.0.0, 4.0.1 or 4.0.2: your time will be 6 seconds shorter on the leaderboards to compensate for slower loading times.

**Video:**

- After the speedrun ends, open the “Map” tab and scroll through all 6 sites to verify that all collectables were obtained. 
- Then scroll through all Sites in the "Kettles" tab to verify that all levels were completed with every weapon.
- The version number must be visible and legible.
- Speedruns that are within the top 5 placements require clearly audible game audio.
- All speedruns must have permanent video proof present.

levels.name: (C-1) - Octarians in the Crater? YIKES!
levels.rules:
- You may play on a new or completed file.  
- Losing all of your lives, going to the 'Continue?' screen, and Retrying from Checkpoint is not allowed. However, dying without going to this screen is allowed.  
- Pausing the game on a specific frame to end a level faster is not allowed.  
- Editing Switch clips together for a run is allowed.  
- Runs may be verified with a video or screenshot of the ending time.  
*(If your submission doesn't show the end screen with the time, your run will be rejected)*  
- Top 3 submissions require full video and audio proof. Video must show you entering the level, playing the entire level and showing the end screen. Final time can not be obscured. If areas of the screen are obscured then the run will be evaluated on a case by case basis.  
- Use the In-Game Timer in the end screen, after completing the level to see your run time.  
*(do not use the milliseconds shown on splatnet in your submission)*  
---
- 新規データもしくは既にクリアされたデータでプレイしてください。  
- 全てのライフを失ったあと、「Continue」画面が出ます。この時「チェックポイントからやり直す」を選択することは禁止ですが、「Continue」画面を介さずに死ぬことは認められます。  
- ある特定のフレームでポーズ画面を開き、ステージを早くクリアすることは禁止です。  
- Switchの機能で撮影されたクリップを繋げてひとつの記録にすることは認められています。  
- クリア時の画面が映っている動画、もしくはスクリーンショットでの記録は承認されることがあります。  
(タイムが左下に表示されてる画面がない申請は棄却されます。)  
- 3位以内となる記録には音声とフレームが欠けていない動画が必須です。動画にはスタート前、プレイ中、そしてクリア後のタイムが表示された画面が必ず含まれていなければなりません。最後のタイムを見えなくすることは不可能です。もし画面の一部が見えなくなっている場合は、時と場合によって評価されます。  
- ゲーム内でのクリアタイムのみを参照します。  
(イカリング3で見ることが出来るコンマ以下のタイムは申請に使用しないでください。)
